sources.title: Cats Protection: Other cats
sources.method: Web reader; relevant page sections read
facts: Not every resident cat welcomes a companion; introductions should be gradual.
Provide opportunities for separation and height, and essential resources for each cat plus a spare distributed around the home.
A single large litter box does not replace separately distributed resources.

sources.title: Cats Protection: Preparing for a cat
facts: Provide an initial separate room and a place to hide and rest while a new cat settles.
Keep the litter tray away from food and water.

sources.title: Cats Protection: Cat sitter checklist
sources.method: Web reader PDF text, one-page checklist
facts: Checklist covers supply locations, feeding instructions, water, litter and disposal, medication, owner and veterinary contacts, and companionship or play preferences.

sources.title: FDA: Tips for Safe Handling of Pet Food and Treats
facts: Wash hands before and after handling pet food, and wash bowls and utensils after use.
Promptly refrigerate or discard unused canned or pouched pet food. This does not validate a particular feeder's storage temperature or duration.
